summary.headline: Granules FY26 revenue rose 20% to INR53,656 million and Q4 EBITDA grew 40% YoY to INR3,521 million, with 23.9% margin.
summary.overview: FY26 was described by management as a year of stabilisation and reset, with revenue crossing INR50,000 million and six straight quarters of sequential growth. Gross margin reached 65% for the year (up 355 bps) and 65.7% in Q4, helped by the peptide CDMO vertical (Senn/Ascelis) turning EBITDA positive in Q4. Net debt fell to INR4,021 million after a INR6,656 million equity infusion, but management guided to flat-to-slightly-higher net debt in FY27 on capex, working capital and raw material cost pressure. Gagillapur US FDA re-inspection timing remains unknown and management would not give a timeline.

financial_highlights.change: FY25 INR5,700 million; Q3 FY26 INR1,298 million
vs 16.8% in Q3 FY26 and 16.6% in FY25

segments.name: Finished dosages
segments.commentary: Core business at 74% of FY26 revenue per management; Q4 described as operationally stable across API and FD.

segments.name: Europe
segments.commentary: Grew 81% YoY and is about 15% of total revenue; 49% growth excluding Senn.

segments.name: Peptide CDMO (Senn / Ascelis)
segments.commentary: Contributed INR1,593 million (3% of FY26 revenue) and turned EBITDA positive in Q4; Ascelis loss of INR445 million included in FY26 EBITDA. Q4 CDMO revenue about INR70 crore versus INR33 crore in the prior period per the CFO's comparison.

segments.name: API
segments.commentary: Growth of about 33% YoY in Q4 attributed to new APIs and internally developed APIs sold externally, not price increases.

guidance_outlook: FY27 capex guided at roughly INR600-odd crore, broad-based, including a new API facility, IT, and a US distribution centre (INR200 crore-plus for distribution).
Remediation spend expected to be substantially lower in FY27 than H1 FY26; cumulative FY26 remediation spend about INR50-plus crore.
Net debt expected to be flattish or slightly up in FY27 due to capex timing and higher working capital from cost escalation.
Working capital to sales to be maintained in the 33% range.
Peptide CDMO aims for PAT-positive performance on an annual basis in FY27, with quarterly variation expected.
Management declined to commit to gross margin percentage for FY27, citing raw material and freight cost uncertainty; price increases to pass through input costs are expected but not assured.
Controlled substance and complex product launches: 9 applications awaiting clearance from Gagillapur; first finished dosage revenue from ADHD products in about 2 years, APIs possibly earlier.
capex_capacity: Gagillapur: US FDA warning letter remediation; cleaning validation completed across PFI, MUPS and FD blocks; management says ready for an anytime FDA audit but has no FDA timeline.
Chantilly GPI site: routine US FDA inspection in March-April 2026 resulted in 4 procedural Form 483 observations, no data integrity findings; responses submitted.
Zurich peptide API capacity expansion and infrastructure upgrades; capacity expected to come online in H2 FY27 with quick utilisation expected per management.
India peptide intermediate brownfield facility expected over the coming months; India peptide API facility at planning stage, at least a year away.
Granules CZRO DCDA commercial plant in Vizag: pilot nearing completion in 2-2.5 months; project cost about INR200 crore, numbers to be frozen shortly.
demand_pricing: Raw material prices, packing material and freight costs have risen due to West Asia situation; management says no price increases achieved yet but expects them to compensate, with a lag, while current inventory covers 1-2 quarters.
Chinese competitors cutting DCDA prices sharply, pressuring the CZRO pilot project economics.
Peptide CDMO customers are spread across double-digit customers across big pharma, virtual biotechs and cosmetics; management says concentration is not high.
Cosmetic TFA-free peptides showing increased traction over the last two quarters.
Lisdexamfetamine: management says quota is as budgeted for FY27 and on-time, in-full supply is in place; sales figure not disclosed.

qa_highlights.question: Pricing for paracetamol and metformin amid West Asia situation, and drivers of 33% API growth in Q4?
qa_highlights.answer: No price increases yet despite rising raw material costs; API growth came from new APIs launched and internally developed APIs sold externally, not pricing.

qa_highlights.question: Is Ascelis/Senn EBITDA breakeven sustainable?
qa_highlights.answer: Management targets sustainable profitability from FY27; individual quarters may vary with customer milestones and shipment timing, with direction towards annual EBITDA and PAT positivity.

qa_highlights.question: FY27 gross margin outlook and Q-o-Q expansion driver?
qa_highlights.answer: Q-o-Q gross margin gain driven mainly by CDMO growth (INR33 crore to INR70 crore) at higher gross margin; FY27 margin percentage not committed given cost uncertainty.

qa_highlights.question: Capex plan and remediation spend for FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: FY27 capex about INR600-odd crore, including INR200 crore-plus for US distribution; remediation spend FY26 about INR50-plus crore, substantially lower from FY27.

qa_highlights.question: When will the Gagillapur US FDA re-inspection happen?
qa_highlights.answer: Activities declared complete with FDA; management ready for an anytime audit but cannot estimate when FDA will visit; no communication from FDA on timing.

qa_highlights.question: Net debt trajectory for FY27?
qa_highlights.answer: Flattish to slight increase in net debt, given capex timing and higher working capital from cost escalation.

risks_watch: Gagillapur US FDA re-inspection timing is unknown and remediation outcome remains open; the warning letter is over a year old.
Raw material, packaging and freight inflation from the West Asia situation may squeeze gross margins before price increases pass through.
Peptide CDMO quarterly lumpiness; project-driven revenue with undisclosed split between R&D and commercial supply and no order book disclosed.
Net debt and working capital may rise in FY27 as capex and working capital build.
Chinese price competition in DCDA and the CZRO commercial plant decision (about INR200 crore) pending pilot completion.
summary.management_tone: Confident on operating momentum and the peptide CDMO turnaround, but notably cautious on FY27 margins, pricing and the FDA timeline, where management declined to give numbers or dates. Evasive on product-level revenue, Senn order book and controlled-substance quota specifics.
key_quotes: FY '26 marked a year of deliberate reset and measurable progress for Granules India.

The business turned EBITDA positive within the third quarter post-acquisition, validating the investment thesis and establishing peptides and CDMO as a meaningful long-term growth engine for Granules.
But all said and done, still uncertain period.
We're ready for an anytime audit.

Zurich peptide API capacity expansion and infrastructure upgrades
India peptide API facility (at planning stage, at least a year away)

growth.why: No FY27 revenue guidance given; management withdrew gross margin guidance and guides only to flattish-to-slightly-higher net debt, FY27 capex of ~INR600 crore broad-based (new API facility, IT, US distribution centre), and peptide CDMO PAT-positive on annual basis, with Q4 revenue +23% YoY and EBITDA +40% YoY but no quantified forward growth backing beyond capacity timing.
